name: Flange Adaptors
oneLineScope: Pipe-to-flange transition couplings for plain-end pipe, 50 – 1,200 mm NB

types.name: Standard flange adaptor
types.description: Single-bolt-circle adaptor connecting plain-end pipe to a flanged fitting or valve.

types.name: Stepped flange adaptor
types.description: Stepped bore for connecting pipes of different outside diameters at a transition.

types.name: Anchor flange
types.description: Heavy-duty adaptor with anti-thrust ribs for use at fixed points in a piping system.

faqs.question: What is a flange adaptor?
faqs.answer: A flange adaptor is a mechanical coupling that connects plain-end (unthreaded, un-flanged) pipe to a flanged valve, fitting or equipment. A stainless-steel bolt compresses a rubber seal ring against the pipe OD to form a pressure-tight joint.

faqs.question: What pipe materials can a flange adaptor connect?
faqs.answer: Flange adaptors suit ductile iron, steel, GRP, uPVC and HDPE pipe — any pipe whose outside diameter falls within the adaptor's specified OD range. Consult the OD tolerance table for the line size before ordering.

faqs.question: What pressure ratings are available?
faqs.answer: Pressure capability data are pending from engineering. Precise Engineers is ISO 9001:2015 certified and EIL approved, and can confirm the appropriate pressure class for your application.

faqs.question: Which flange standards are available?
faqs.answer: Flange adaptors are drilled to ANSI B16.1, BS 4504 (EN 1092) or DIN 2501 as standard. Mixed drilling and special bolt circles are available on request.

faqs.question: What seal grades are offered?
faqs.answer: EPDM for water and mild chemicals, NBR for oil and fuel service, and Neoprene for general industrial service. Precise Engineers selects the seal grade based on medium and operating temperature.
